title: Review of Rule for 80% of Funds Raised for Foreign Charitable Purposes to be Applied in Singapore
what_it_is: Review of Rule for 80% of Funds Raised for Foreign Charitable Purposes to be Applied in Singapore

sections.label: Waiver of 80:20 rule
sections.summary: The 80:20 rule stays relevant, and the COC waives it for some appeals, considering factors case by case.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The intent of this 80:20 rule remains relevant.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Besides appeals in aid of providing immediate disaster or humanitarian relief to other countries, the Commissioner of Charities (COC) also waives this 80:20 rule for certain private fund-raising appeals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: It would not be practical to provide a specific list of activities that would be eligible for waiver, as the COC considers a range of aspects in making its decisions, such as the nature of the appeal, target donor groups and beneficiaries, and the safeguards in place to mitigate risks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: But should an applicant wish to apply for a waiver of the rule based on its circumstances, the applicant may put forth its reasons for waiver of the rule in its application for fundraising for foreign charitable purposes permit to the COC.

sections.label: COC foreign fundraising permits
sections.summary: In 2021 the COC granted 78 permits for foreign charitable appeals and waived the 80:20 rule case by case.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In fact, in 2021, COC granted a total 78 permits for organisations to conduct fund-raising appeals for foreign charitable purposes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The COC, as I have mentioned earlier, can, on a case-by-case basis, waive this 80:20 rule, such as for appeals in aid of providing immediate disaster relief and for private donations raised for foreign charitable causes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In fact, they have done so, including for private appeals and appeals for relief efforts going to causes, such as for COVID-19 in many different countries, for the Malaysian floods in December last year and January this year, and also for Typhoon Rai, which affected and afflicted the Philippines in December.

sections.label: Review of charity regulations
sections.summary: The COC reviews charity regulations regularly and will consider the Member's feedback in the next review.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In this regard, the COC carries out reviews of the charity regulations on a regular basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We will consider the Member's feedback and, in fact, welcome the Member's feedback in the next review.
